title: Orphans Court
clean_html:
Orphans Court

Preserved Primary Document • orphans.htm

Orphans Court records cover many of the legal matters concerning the welfare of orphaned (i.e. fatherless) children. If a person died intestate, the Orphans Court would handle the sale and/or distribution of any land or property and/or the value of any yearly rents with the proceeds going to the heirs. It would also assign any necessary guardians for minor children. I am only just begining to work on this section and hope to include more as time goes by. Preserved Primary Document • orphans.htm




Orphans Court records cover many of the legal matters concerning the welfare of orphaned (i.e. fatherless) children. 

If a person died intestate, the Orphans Court would handle the sale and/or distribution of any land or property and/or the value of any yearly rents with the proceeds going to the heirs. It would also assign any necessary guardians for minor children. 

I am only just begining to work on this section and hope to include more as time goes by.
